**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (redline at preferred level).**

- **What's wrong:** § 14.10 (p0188) is one-sided. Customer needs IBM's consent for any assignment other than to a merger/consolidation/acquisition successor (so even an intra-group affiliate transfer needs consent), while IBM is entirely unrestricted and could assign to a competitor of ours. No change-of-control termination right exists anywhere in the document (searches for "change of control" and the termination provisions returned nothing), so that element is only confirmatory.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the fallback requires that *every* non-successor assignment need consent — that must bind IBM too, and here it binds only us.
- **Cure (2 ops, minimality validated):** freed our affiliate/successor assignments (adding "sale of substantially all assets"), subjected IBM assignment to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a no-competitor bar, and added one short sentence confirming no IBM termination on our change of control. The retained "void assignment" and continuing-liability sentences are untouched and still read coherently.
